h1: Custom Gray Tape Measures for Branded Promotions
metaTitle: Custom Gray Tape Measures | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gray tape measures with your logo. Ideal for contractors and DIYers. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gray tape measures offer a professional, neutral look that blends well with tool belts and workshop environments. Unlike brighter colors, gray doesn't show dirt as easily, making it a practical choice for contractors and DIYers who use their tape measures daily. Customize with your logo using screen printing or laser engraving for a durable, long-lasting brand impression that stands up to job site conditions.
